question: Which of the fruits shown in the 2008 painting "Embroidery from Uzbekistan" were served as part of the October 1949 breakfast menu for the ocean liner that was later used as a floating prop for the film "The Last Voyage"? Give the items as a comma-separated list, ordering them in clockwise order based on their arrangement in the painting starting from the 12 o'clock position. Use the plural form of each fruit.

history.content: I opened a Pinterest pin titled "Embroidery from Uzbekistan by Janet Fish (2008)". The image is clearer. Observations: Near the 12 o’clock area there is a glass bowl with several green pears. Slightly to the right (around 1–2 o’clock), a cluster of yellow bananas arcs out of a bowl. Around 4–5 o’clock, there are reddish grapes in a glass container. Near 7 o’clock, small yellow lemons appear on a dish. At roughly 9–10 o’clock, I can make out red apples partially obscured by a textile. The composition includes textiles and a vase; the dominant fruits visible are pears and bananas with supporting fruits like grapes, lemons, and some apples.

No formal list of fruit types is provided in text, but the visual corroborates pears-and-bananas prominence.

history.content: Next, find the October 1949 breakfast menu for SS Île de France (the liner used as a floating prop in "The Last Voyage") and list the fruit items exactly as shown.

history.name: WebSurfer
history.content: I opened GG Archives: "Continental Elegance at Sea: A 1949 First-Class Breakfast Aboard the SS Ile de France" (October 1949). The fruit items listed include: honey dew, grapefruit, red raisin, orange, pear, white raisin, bananas, apple. There are also juices (grapefruit, orange, pineapple, tomato) and jams/marmalades, but for whole fruits the key items are apples, bananas, pears, oranges, grapefruit, and honey dew; raisins are present as red/white.

Apples are likely present in the painting and are on the menu, but they are less prominent than pears/bananas. Grapes in the painting map to raisins on the menu (processed), so we should exclude grapes if strictly requiring whole fruits. From the painting’s arrangement starting at 12 o’clock: pears at 12, then bananas clockwise. Preliminary matched list would be pears, bananas.
